text:
sophie: quick heads-up, i'm opening a small docs PR for the new slim variant. plan: add a compact compatibility checklist, supported limits, a short bench summary, and two usage examples (python SDK v3 + curl).

ashley: nice. can you call out the 4096 seq fallback explicitly? dedicated runtime teams reported unexpected reroutes. :eyes: 

sophie: yep — i’ll add a sentence under Limits: fallback to slim-3b-quant on low-memory nodes at >4096 seq and note perf/quality delta.

mira: for embeddings, could we show a minimal shard-aware example? something like:

```python
# shard id helper (illustrative)
def shard_id_for_key(key, num_shards):
    return hash(key) % num_shards

# usage
emb = client.embeddings.create(model=\"slim-3b\", input=[text], shard_id=shard_id_for_key(key,8))
```

mira: put that under \"Embeddings -> Sharding\" and link to /docs/embeddings#shard-routing (anchor updated).

chris: small operational note: our routing policy may map slim-3b -> slim-3b-quant on constrained nodes; call out expected numbers (slower and slightly fuzzier).

sophie: will add: \"On constrained nodes requests to slim-3b may be served by slim-3b-quant; expect ~1.2x higher latency and minor output variance.\" keep wording simple.

paul: can we include the bench CSV link and paste headline numbers inline? makes the doc actionable.

docs-bot: bench CSV link: https://bench.redwood.internal/slim-3b/latest.csv

sophie: adding inline benches: p4d: ~420 tok/s @512 seq; g5: ~680 tok/s @512 seq. quant fallback: p4d: ~330 tok/s, g5: ~520 tok/s. i'll reference the CSV for details.

ashley: tiny SDK nit: use `max_tokens` in examples for SDK v3 instead of `length`. also add a one-line migration tip: search/replace `length` -> `max_tokens` when moving v2->v3.

sophie: done. python generate snippet will use client.generate(..., max_tokens=256). curl example will show the REST param `max_tokens` too.

mira: anchor fix confirmed — recent rename changed the old anchor. i'll validate the link in the PR preview.

chris: can someone run Spell/MD linter after push? i’ll do the final pass for wording and accessibility checks.

sophie: branch pushed: refs/heads/docs/slim-compat-1755554321. PR body will include a short checklist: 1) limits + fallback note, 2) embed sharding snippet + anchor, 3) sdk v3 generate snippet, 4) curl example, 5) bench numbers + CSV link, 6) compatibility note about quant routing.

paul: ETA?

sophie: aiming to merge tomorrow EOD if no blockers. requesting reviewers: @ashley @chris @mira.

ashley: LGTM to review once it's up. i'll confirm the fallback phrasing.

mira: i'll check the embed snippet and update the anchor if needed.

chris: will run linter and bench sanity tomorrow morning.

sophie: thanks team — will post the PR link here when it's live. :rocket:
